description: Modern GUI redesign: sidebar layout, rich app rows, prominent search bar with clear button and history dropdown, persistent 4-segment status bar, per-app install progress panel, redesigned toolbar/header, category filter in sidebar, Ctrl+D shortcut, tooltips, empty-state messages, and dark/light theme completeness. All changes in ui.py, with supporting additions to theme.py, config.py, helptext.py, and catalog.py/models.py for category data. FEAT-002 depends on FEAT-001 (must be implemented after FEAT-001).
steps: 1. flatpak_batch_installer/models.py — add `category: str = ''` field to the App dataclass (frozen=True, default empty string). This is a backward-compatible addition because it has a default.

2. flatpak_batch_installer/catalog.py — add CATEGORY_MAP: dict[str, str] mapping common app-ID prefixes to category names (e.g. 'org.gnome.' -> 'GNOME', 'org.kde.' -> 'KDE', 'com.valvesoftware.' -> 'Gaming', 'org.libreoffice.' -> 'Office', 'org.mozilla.' -> 'Internet', 'com.google.' -> 'Internet', 'org.gimp.' -> 'Graphics', 'org.inkscape.' -> 'Graphics', 'org.audacityteam.' -> 'Audio', 'net.lutris.' -> 'Gaming'). In parse_remote_ls(), after creating App, set category by iterating CATEGORY_MAP and checking if app_id.startswith(prefix); default to 'Other'. Also add `category` parameter to filter_rows() (default None = no filter; when set, only include apps where app.category == category).

3. flatpak_batch_installer/ui.py — restructure _build_widgets() to a sidebar layout: replace the single vertical stack with a top header bar + horizontal PanedWindow. Left pane (fixed ~220px): 'Search' label + ttk.Combobox (state='normal', width=22, self.filter_var) for search with history; 'Clear ✕' button bound to clear_filter(); separator; 'Status' label + status_filter Combobox; 'Category' label + category_filter Combobox (values=['All'] + sorted categories); separator; 'Scope' frame with two ttk.Radiobutton (User/System); separator; 'Select Page' button; 'Clear Selection' button (label 'Clear (Ctrl+D)'). Right pane: Treeview + pager frame. Keep the exact same column definitions and bindings.

4. flatpak_batch_installer/ui.py — redesign the top header bar (ttk.Frame, padding=(8,6,8,6)): left side: 32px app icon (load_icon(subsample=8)), ttk.Label 'Flatpak Batch Installer' (bold, large font); right side: Install button (Accent.TButton, text updated by _update_install_btn_label()), 'Update All' button, 'Refresh' button (F5), Options menubutton, Help menubutton. The scope radio buttons move to the left sidebar (step 3). Remove the old 'Load catalog' button from the toolbar (Refresh serves this role; also F5). Keep the Options and Help menus identical in content.

5. flatpak_batch_installer/ui.py — persistent 4-segment status bar at the bottom: `ttk.Frame` with `ttk.Label` widgets: segment 1 `self.total_var` (e.g. 'Total: 0 apps'), ttk.Separator(orient='vertical'), segment 2 `self.selected_count` (e.g. 'Selected: 0'), ttk.Separator(orient='vertical'), segment 3 `self.scope_badge_var` (e.g. 'Scope: user'), ttk.Separator(orient='vertical'), segment 4 `self.status` (last-action text, fills remaining width). Add `self.total_var = tk.StringVar(value='Total: 0 apps')` and `self.scope_badge_var = tk.StringVar(value=f'Scope: {DEFAULT_SCOPE}')` in __init__. Update total_var in apply_filter (after loading). Update scope_badge_var when scope changes.

6. flatpak_batch_installer/ui.py — per-app install progress panel: replace the raw tk.Text log with a two-panel approach: (a) a ttk.Frame `self.progress_panel` (height ~120px, initially hidden) containing a ttk.Treeview with columns (app_id, status_text) and rows auto-populated from `ids` at install start with status 'Queued'; (b) a collapsible tk.Text log (toggle button 'Show log'). In the install worker, parse on_line output for patterns like 'Installing APP_ID' or 'app_id' substrings to update the matching row status to 'Installing...', 'Done' or 'Failed'. Show progress_panel before install starts, hide after (or keep visible with results). The per-app Treeview rows should use tag colors: queued=default, installing=accent, done=green, failed=red.

7. flatpak_batch_installer/ui.py — rich app rows: set Treeview rowheight=44 in _build_widgets (override theme default). Add tag 'name_bold' with font=bold to name column rendering. Since ttk.Treeview tags only support foreground/background/font uniformly per row, use a combined approach: for each row, the 'name' cell shows 'NAME — summary' formatted string in the name column, and the summary column shows the app_id (swap for readability). Actually simpler and more correct: keep existing columns but configure 'summary_muted' tag with foreground=dim-color and apply it to all rows alongside 'even'/'odd'. Add `self.tree.tag_configure('summary_muted', foreground=muted_fg)` in apply_filter based on current theme. The Treeview name column shows app.name in bold via a per-row 'name_bold' font tag.

8. flatpak_batch_installer/ui.py — app detail side panel: replace the plain `self.detail` ttk.Label with a collapsible `ttk.Frame` detail panel below the Treeview (inside the right pane). The panel has: ttk.Label `self.detail_name_var` (large bold font), ttk.Label `self.detail_id_var` (muted, monospace), ttk.Label `self.detail_status_var` (badge style), tk.Text `self.detail_summary_text` (3 lines, read-only, word-wrap). On_row_focus populates these. Panel hidden when nothing is selected; shown on first row focus.

9. flatpak_batch_installer/ui.py — search history: add `self._search_history: list[str] = []` in __init__. After apply_filter() finds matches > 0, if filter_var.get().strip() is non-empty and not already in history, insert at position 0 and trim to 5. Update the search Combobox values via `self.filter_entry.configure(values=self._search_history)`. Bind `<<ComboboxSelected>>` on the search Combobox to trigger schedule_filter().

10. flatpak_batch_installer/ui.py — category filter wiring: add `self.category_var = tk.StringVar(value='All')` in __init__. In apply_filter(), read category_var; if != 'All', pass `category=category_var.get()` to filter_rows(). Bind category Combobox <<ComboboxSelected>> to `lambda e: (setattr(self, 'page', 0), self.apply_filter())`. Populate category Combobox values after catalog load: `['All'] + sorted({app.category for app in self.all_rows} - {''})`.

11. flatpak_batch_installer/ui.py — install count badge: add `_update_install_btn_label(self)` method that sets Install button text to `f'Install ({n})' if n > 0 else 'Install'` where n=len(self.selected_ids). Call this from update_count(). Keep button reference as `self.install_btn`.

12. flatpak_batch_installer/ui.py — Ctrl+D shortcut: add `self.bind('<Control-d>', lambda e: self.clear_selection())` in _build_shortcuts(). flatpak_batch_installer/helptext.py — add ('Ctrl+D', 'Deselect all apps') to SHORTCUTS list. Update tests/test_ui.py test_shortcuts_registered to include '<Control-d>'.

13. flatpak_batch_installer/ui.py — tooltips: implement `_ToolTip` inner class (or module-level class) that creates a `tk.Toplevel` on `<Enter>` event and destroys it on `<Leave>`. Add helper `self._add_tooltip(widget, text)`. Apply tooltips to: install_btn, refresh/update-all buttons, search entry, clear-filter button, Select Page button, Clear Selection button, scope radio buttons, status-filter combobox, category combobox, pager Prev/Next buttons, page-size combobox, Options and Help menubuttons.

14. flatpak_batch_installer/ui.py — empty states: in apply_filter(), when tree would be empty, insert a single disabled placeholder row. Three cases: (a) no catalog loaded: insert ('', '', 'No catalog loaded', 'Click Refresh to load', '') with tag 'placeholder'; (b) no matches for current filter: insert ('', '', 'No results', 'Try a different search term or filter', '') with tag 'placeholder'; (c) catalog loaded but empty: insert warning. Tag 'placeholder' configures foreground=muted, background=even_stripe. These rows are skipped in on_tree_click and on_row_focus (check row not in row_by_iid).

15. flatpak_batch_installer/theme.py + ui.py — dark/light theme completeness: in _set_dark(), after applying Polish, call a new `_recolor_sidebar(on)` method that re-applies background/foreground to the left-panel Labels, Frames, and the detail panel Text widgets. Ensure the progress_panel Treeview rows also get stripe tags reapplied. In polish_active_theme(), configure 'Placeholder.TLabel' style with muted foreground for empty-state rows.

16. tests/test_ui.py — update test_modern_chrome (no menubar, help dropdown still present), test_options_menu (assert new layout still has User/System/Update/Save/Load/Dark mode), test_shortcuts_registered (add Ctrl+D). Add new tests: test_install_btn_badge (select 3 apps, confirm button text 'Install (3)'), test_search_history (run 3 searches, confirm _search_history length 3), test_category_filter_populates (load 10 apps with mixed categories, confirm category combobox values include the categories), test_empty_state_no_catalog (apply_filter with no rows, confirm placeholder row in tree).
acceptance_criteria: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v — all tests pass.
Left sidebar is visible with search, status filter, category filter, and scope controls.
Install button shows 'Install (N)' when N > 0 apps are selected.
Ctrl+D deselects all apps (registered shortcut, triggers clear_selection).
Empty catalog state shows a placeholder row in the Treeview, not a blank table.
Search history dropdown accumulates up to 5 recent non-empty searches.
Category filter combobox is populated after catalog load.
Tooltips appear on at least 8 interactive elements (verified by _tooltip_widgets count or manual inspection).
Theme toggle applies colors to sidebar, detail panel, and progress panel (no orphan white/black widgets in dark mode).
findings:
All 16 steps implemented and verified (54 tests pass, compileall clean). Key notes for FEAT-003+:

1. models.py: App dataclass now has `category: str = ''` as a fourth field. Tests constructing App directly must pass category or accept the default '' — test_catalog.py ParseTest tests updated to supply the correct category value.
2. catalog.py: CATEGORY_MAP dict added (10 entries). `_categorize(app_id)` helper assigns category from prefix match or 'Other'. `parse_remote_ls()` now sets category on every App. `filter_rows()` has a new `category: str | None = None` parameter — None = no filter, any string value = exact match against app.category. CATEGORY_MAP exported in __all__.
3. helptext.py: SHORTCUTS list now has 10 entries (Ctrl+D 'Deselect all apps' added between Ctrl+A and Space).
4. ui.py — new attributes added in __init__: `self.category_var` (StringVar, default 'All'), `self.total_var` (StringVar), `self.scope_badge_var` (StringVar), `self._search_history` (list[str]), `self._tooltip_widgets` (list[_ToolTip]).
5. ui.py — layout: replaced single-column layout with `ttk.PanedWindow(orient='horizontal')`. Left sidebar is `ttk.Frame` at ~224px named `self._sidebar_frame`. Right pane is `ttk.Frame`. The old `self.detail` StringVar/Label is REMOVED — replaced by a collapsible `self._detail_panel` (ttk.Frame) with four sub-widgets: `self.detail_name_lbl`, `self.detail_id_lbl`, `self.detail_status_lbl`, `self.detail_summary_text`. Panel starts hidden (`_detail_panel_visible = False`), shown on first row focus.
6. ui.py — sidebar widgets: `self.filter_entry` is now a `ttk.Combobox` (was ttk.Entry), `self.category_cb` is a new ttk.Combobox for category filter. Scope radio buttons are in the sidebar (not the header).
7. ui.py — header: `self.install_btn` (Accent.TButton), `refresh_btn`, `update_btn`, `options_btn` (Menubutton), `help_btn` (Menubutton) all on the right side of the header bar. Old 'Load catalog' button removed; Refresh replaces it.
8. ui.py — status bar: 4-segment persistent bar at bottom (total_var | selected_count | scope_badge_var | status). Progressbar and busy_label_var moved to status bar right side.
9. ui.py — progress panel: `self.progress_panel` (ttk.Frame, hidden by default) with `self._progress_tree` (ttk.Treeview, columns app_id/install_status). Tags: queued/installing/done/failed. Shown on install start. `self._progress_iids` dict maps app_id → iid (created at install time, not __init__).
10. ui.py — `_ToolTip` class added at module level. `self._add_tooltip(widget, text)` registers tooltips; 13+ widgets have tooltips.
11. ui.py — `_toggle_log()` method added; log area has a 'Hide'/'Show Log' toggle button `self._log_toggle_btn`.
12. ui.py — `_on_scope_change()` method updates scope_badge_var and calls load_catalog(). Options menu scope radios and sidebar radio buttons both call this.
13. ui.py — Treeview rowheight set to 44 in `_apply_polish()` (overrides theme default of 26).
14. ui.py — `apply_filter()` now calls `filter_rows(..., category=cat)` using category_var; updates total_var; inserts placeholder rows for empty states tagged 'placeholder' (not in row_by_iid).
15. ui.py — `_recolor_sidebar(on)` method added; called from `_apply_polish()` to recolor sidebar Labels in non-bootstrap mode.
16. tests/test_ui.py: setUp now also resets `category_var`, `_search_history`, and filter_entry values. 10 new tests added: test_install_btn_badge, test_search_history, test_category_filter_populates, test_empty_state_no_catalog, test_empty_state_no_matches, test_sidebar_has_category_combobox, test_scope_badge_updates, test_tooltips_attached, test_ctrl_d_clears_selection, test_total_var_updates.
